"""HOSTILE FIXTURE: lower only in the executor's bounded probe container."""

from pathlib import Path

FRAMEWORK = "jax"
INPUTS = {"inputs/features": ((3,), "float32")}


def init(key):
    return []


def forward(params, x):
    print("HOSTILE_L4_PROBE:scratch_flood", flush=True)
    scratch = Path("/scratch/hostile-l4-flood")
    scratch.mkdir()
    block = bytes(1 << 20)
    n = 0
    while True:
        (scratch / str(n)).write_bytes(block)
        n += 1
